XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Sporadically: engine fault light comes on and misfiring occurs.

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Reliability rating key

* low level : Reported by a garage mechanic; fault case not recorded by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Widespread occurrence of the fault, confirmed by service technicians and independent repairers.

*** high level : Confirmed fault, with a high degree of ‘recurrence’ reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Component: Ignition coil

  • Fault: The engine occasionally misfires and the engine fault warning light comes on

  • Errors detected by the self-diagnostic system:
    • P0300 (Misfire in unspecified cylinders – Generic fault)
    • P0301 (Misfire in cylinder 1 – Generic fault)
  • Cause: Faulty ignition coil

• Action: Check that the ignition coil is working correctly and, if necessary, replace it

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The vehicle is fitted with an ignition coil that manages the ignition for all four cylinders.
    In this case, the ignition coil, complete with spark plug leads, was replaced, thereby permanently resolving the fault.
